name: chief-of-staff
description: Researcher searches an in-memory vector store with Local Hash Embeddings and a plain-text note. Analyst uses PostgreSQL MCP when CUTTLELY_ANALYST=auto, or when CUTTLELY_POSTGRES_URL names a separate database. No database URL is stored.

chief.instructions: Document questions go to the researcher. Database questions go to the analyst. Do not invent sources or query results.

specialists.name: researcher
specialists.instructions: Retrieve passages from the in-memory vector store and return them with their sources.

inputs.text: Cuttlely chief-of-staff sample. The researcher reads this note from an in-memory store. Local Hash Embeddings built the vectors, with no provider key. The analyst stays off until CUTTLELY_ANALYST=auto, which creates isolated storage. CUTTLELY_POSTGRES_URL still names a separate database when you set it.

specialists.name: analyst
specialists.instructions: Answer database questions with the PostgreSQL MCP tools. Return only what those tools return.
